report.verdict: A senior backend engineer with payments, ledger and production migration work that fits much of Cobalt Pay's role.
write_up: Your resume tells a strong story: you build payment services at Lumen Ledger, after backend work in freight and insurance. The payouts service, ledger migration and balance API improvements give a recruiter concrete reasons to consider you for a senior backend role.

The balance API line is a great model: it names the latency before and after and explains what you changed. Your experience is also easy to follow, with recent payments work leading the resume. Cobalt Pay will still look for details about your role in on-call, design reviews and financial controls.

Start by tailoring the Lumen Ledger section to those responsibilities where you have firsthand experience. Then add detail to the older claims service line. Your resume is strong as it stands; the match to Cobalt Pay's remaining requirements and how competitive the role is will also matter.

cards.line: Maintained the claims intake services in Java
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows which services you worked on, but not what maintaining them involved. A concrete change would show more of your Java work.
cards.example: Maintained the claims intake services in Java by [work you did]
cards.question: What work did you do on the claims intake services?

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 3
cards.line: Cut p99 latency on the balance API from 900 ms to 140 ms by moving reads to a Kafka-fed cache
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. The API, the change and the two latency figures give a recruiter something concrete to remember.

cards.where: Senior Software Engineer, Payments Platform, line 2
cards.line: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends
cards.cannot_tell: For a role one level above senior, a recruiter will look for technical decisions that reach beyond one migration. Add one if you made it.
cards.example: Led the migration of the ledger from a single Postgres instance to a sharded cluster with zero downtime over six weekends, making [a decision you made] affecting [systems or teams]
cards.question: What decision did you make during the migration that affected other systems or teams?

fit.why: Your headline and current role point to senior backend work, with Go payouts, a ledger migration and production reliability improvements.
fit.level: senior, leads a ledger migration and mentors two engineers
fit.note: The Go payouts service and PostgreSQL ledger work are especially relevant to Cobalt Pay. Put your most relevant firsthand responsibilities near those results so a recruiter can see the connection quickly.
